meta.title: Mohamed Qurtam — Network & Security Engineer
meta.description: Securing networks. Engineering resilient infrastructure. Enterprise firewalls, network segmentation, SIEM monitoring, and incident response.

candidate.name: Mohamed Ahmed Qurtam
candidate.headline: Network & Security Engineer
candidate.subheadline: Network & Security Engineer with Tier 1 SOC Operations Competency
candidate.bio: Working at the intersection of network infrastructure and defensive security. Designing, deploying and securing enterprise infrastructure across the MENA region at Co-brand Solution.

bullets: Architect, configure, and maintain enterprise perimeter defense using Palo Alto Networks NGFW and Fortinet FortiGate appliances.
Implement micro-segmentation, zero-trust network access (ZTNA), and multi-vendor IPsec VPN tunnels across distributed branch sites.
Integrate centralized syslog and SIEM feeds for real-time security event telemetry, alert correlation, and incident triage.
Configured Cisco Catalyst switching hierarchies (VLANs, VTP, STP/RSTP, EtherChannel) and dynamic routing (OSPF, EIGRP, BGP).
Engineered redundant gateway protocols (HSRP/VRRP) and deployed ACL policies enforcing least-privilege traffic flow.
Conducted vulnerability assessments, baseline security hardening, and disaster recovery backup workflows using Veeam Backup & Replication.

education.institution: Benha University · Faculty of Engineering at Shoubra
education.description: An engineering foundation in communication systems, electronics, network theory, and technical problem-solving.

projects.title: Enterprise Palo Alto NGFW & Multi-Zone Security Architecture
projects.summary: Full design and implementation of a zero-trust multi-zone perimeter defense architecture leveraging Palo Alto NGFW.

projects.title: High-Availability Core Campus & Datacenter Routing Fabric
projects.summary: Dual-homed campus core network design featuring redundant OSPF/BGP routing, HSRP failover, and LACP link aggregation.
